macro_descriptions.ALARM_WATER_TEMP: Water temperature at which the operator is notified
macro_descriptions.MAX_WATER_TEMP: Maximum water temperature at which the power is switched off
macro_descriptions.MAX_STEAM_TEMP: Maximum vapor temperature at which the power is switched off
macro_descriptions.MAX_ACP_TEMP: Maximum ACP temperature at which the power is switched off
macro_descriptions.CHANGE_POWER_MODE_STEAM_TEMP: Vapor sensor temperature at which the column switches from heat-up to working mode; in distillation with a vapor sensor installed it marks the start of boiling
macro_descriptions.OPEN_VALVE_TANK_TEMP: Boiler sensor temperature at which the water supply valve opens and the water pump turns on
macro_descriptions.DELTA_T_CLOSE_VALVE: Difference between the set water cooling temperature and the water temperature up to which the pump keeps running after distillation or rectification has finished
macro_descriptions.HEAT_DELTA: Difference between the target and current temperature (for beer and sous-vide modes) up to which heating runs at full power (heat-up)
macro_descriptions.ACCELERATION_HEATER_DELTA: If the difference between the target and current temperature (for beer and sous-vide modes) is larger than this value, relay 4 additionally turns on the heat-up heater when a UART-controlled regulator is used; with a smaller difference the heat-up heater turns off
macro_descriptions.PWM_LOW_VALUE: Lower value (in percent) for the PWM pump regulator. Pick a value that still gives a water flow
macro_descriptions.PWM_START_VALUE: Value (in percent) at which the PWM pump regulator starts. Pick a value that reliably starts the motor
macro_descriptions.WF_CALIBRATION: Flow sensor value F=98*Q(L/min); for a different sensor set a different value
macro_descriptions.WATER_FLOW_MIN_PULSES: Flow is considered real if the pulses per cycle are not below this threshold
macro_descriptions.CHEESE_DOSER_STEP_SPEED: Local stepper speed for "By steps" dosing, steps/s
macro_descriptions.NBK_MULT_PAUSE_OVERFLOW: Number of inertias used as the pause after flooding
macro_descriptions.NBK_PUMP_LIMIT: Maximum mash pump flow for Optimization, l/h
macro_descriptions.NBK_WORK_PRESSURE_RATIO: Working pressure ceiling as a share of the flooding pressure (40 mm -> 20 mm)
macro_descriptions.NBK_PRESSURE_MARGIN: mmHg below the pressure at the moment of flooding when learning the ceiling
macro_descriptions.SAMOVAR_USE_POWER_START_TIME: Delay before the heat-up command is sent to the regulator. Needed when the regulator is switched by a contactor, so that the regulator has time to start
macro_descriptions.LCD_RESET_PERIOD_MS: Period (ms) of the periodic menu_reset_lcd(), 4 minutes. It used to be computed as CurMin==120 (uint8_t), i.e. it overflowed every 256 s as a side effect - now it is set explicitly
macro_descriptions.PAUSE_RESUME_HYSTERESIS_DELTA: Hysteresis (°C) between the pause entry threshold by vapor/column temperature and the exit threshold; removes jitter at the boundary
macro_descriptions.PROGRAM_ROW_STOP_PAUSE_LIMIT: Cumulative number of stop-pauses during the current program line (the counter resets when the line changes or when this limit is reached), after which the base rate of the line is reduced automatically
macro_descriptions.PROGRAM_ROW_STOP_PAUSE_SPEED_CUT_PCT: By how many % to reduce the base rate of the line when PROGRAM_ROW_STOP_PAUSE_LIMIT is reached
macro_descriptions.PROGRAM_DONE_AUTO_POWEROFF_MIN: Time (min) to hold the "Program completed" status in total reflux mode: pump stopped, heating continues, the operator can continue take-off; after it expires the power is switched off automatically. 0 = switch off immediately
macro_descriptions.BODY_TEMP_AUTOSET_MAX_RISE: Limit (°C) of the automatic body temperature rise within one program line (the first body line after heads, or pre-flooding followed by two body lines); above it a temperature excess causes a normal pause instead of a new body temperature
macro_descriptions.BK_STEAM_SETPOINT_MIN: Lower limit of the BC dephlegmator vapor temperature setpoint (5th field of the program line), °C; 0 is a special case "water manually"
macro_descriptions.BK_STEAM_SETPOINT_MAX: Upper limit of the BC dephlegmator vapor temperature setpoint, °C
macro_descriptions.BK_WATER_ADJUST_PERIOD_MS: Step period for BC vapor temperature control, ms
macro_descriptions.BK_WATER_DEADBAND: Dead band (°C) around the BC vapor setpoint
macro_descriptions.BK_WATER_PWM_STEP: Pump PWM step for BC vapor temperature control (out of 1023)
macro_descriptions.BLYNK_SAMOVAR_TOOL: Use the free Blynk server samovar-tool.ru instead of the Blynk cloud
macro_descriptions.NOT_USE_INTERFACE_UPDATE: Do not update the interface at startup
macro_descriptions.USE_UPDATE_OTA: Use ArduinoOTA for updating over Wi-Fi. Handy for debugging; during operation it adds extra load on the ESP32
macro_descriptions.KVIC_USE_9600: Use UART speed 9600 for the KVIC regulator (new versions), otherwise 38400
macro_descriptions.USE_NBK_DELTA_PRESSURE: Enable stillage temperature correction by pressure in the stillage drain
macro_descriptions.USE_NBK_END_BY_STEAM_RISE: Additional end-of-mash criterion: finish CBC Work when Tp has risen by NBK_END_STEAM_RISE above the minimum recorded during Work for longer than 2*In
macro_descriptions.USE_WATERSENSOR: Use the cooling water flow sensor. If used and there is no water for the set time, Samovar switches off column heating
macro_descriptions.USE_WATER_PUMP: Use PWM control of the water pump and/or turning on the mixer for beer mode
macro_descriptions.USE_HEAD_LEVEL_SENSOR: Use the reflux level sensor in the head (P-N-P sensor). If used, when the sensor triggers the power is reduced by 1*PWR_FACTOR (for KVIC: 1 V, for RMVK: 2 V; for SEM_AVR: by 3% of the current)
macro_descriptions.IGNORE_HEAD_LEVEL_SENSOR_SETTING: Forbid disabling the reflux sensor in the WEB interface
macro_descriptions.WHLS_HIGH_PULL: Use the N-P-N liquid level sensor
macro_descriptions.USE_ALARM_BTN: Use the emergency button. Pressing it stops the water supply and cuts the power. You can use leak sensors (several in parallel) or an ordinary button (it can also be connected in parallel with the leak sensors)
macro_descriptions.USE_BODY_TEMP_AUTOSET: Use automatic body temperature correction for the first body take-off program or pre-flooding after heads, and for a pre-flooding program if it comes before the last body or pre-flooding take-off program
macro_descriptions.USE_LUA: Use Lua to write scripts for controlling Samovar and the port expander
macro_descriptions.USE_STEPPER_ACCELERATION: Use smooth start and braking of the stepper
macro_descriptions.COLUMN_WETTING: If a reflux level sensor is installed, bring the column to pre-flooding at the start of rectification to wet the packing
macro_descriptions.USE_WATER_VALVE: Use valve control to adjust the water pressure
macro_descriptions.USE_ANALOG_EXPANDER: Use the PCF8591 analog port expander
macro_descriptions.USE_ADS1115: Use ADS1115: the pH sensor is connected to AIN0 automatically
macro_descriptions.I2CStepperStepMl: Number of steps per ml for I2CStepper
macro_descriptions.WETTING_POWER: Regulator voltage/power (for SEM_AVR) during packing wetting
macro_descriptions.USE_PRESSURE_XGZ: use the XGZP6897D pressure sensor (or similar). For the value to use, see the K parameter in the table: https://github.com/fanfanlatulipe26/XGZP6897D
macro_descriptions.PUMP_PWM_FREQ: Cooling pump PWM frequency. 15 Hz is the standard value; any other value is stored only in the local settings file and applied after flashing.
macro_descriptions.SAMOVAR_LANG: Firmware and web interface language. Russian is the default; another language is taken from the lang_<code>.h file in the project folder. The choice is stored in the local settings file user_config_override.h and applied after flashing and LittleFS upload.
macro_descriptions.servoDelta: Correction for the servo rotation angle.
macro_descriptions.SAMOVAR_USE_POWER: use the KVIC voltage regulator in the project https://alcodistillers.ru/forum/viewtopic.php?id=1524
macro_descriptions.SAMOVAR_USE_RMVK: use the RMV-K voltage regulator with UART control in the project
macro_descriptions.SAMOVAR_USE_SEM_AVR: use the power regulator https://alcodistillers.ru/forum/viewtopic.php?id=1549 with UART control in the project
macro_descriptions.USE_BMP280_ALT: use the BMP280 pressure sensor with an alternate address
